why:
  d1/denied: the control plane refused the credential (HTTP 403; needs obs:read): an auth/scope problem, not evidence the data is missing; ask an org admin for the scope
  d1/outside-window: the data exists: the panel has points over the last 7d, newest 2026-10-22T11:31:00Z, but none in the last 1h; the window is shorter than the signal's cadence, or the emitter went quiet
  d1/metric-gone: no data in any env over 7d, and the metric catalog has no such metric (rpc.server.calls): a misspelt name, a metric the collector drops, or an emitter that has not shipped
  d1/daily-bucket: the answer holds one bucket (step 1h over 1h), and a line needs two to draw; widen the window or lower the step
